title: Be Transformed, Not Conformed
question: How does renewing the mind change us, and what does it let us discern?
blurb: One verse, two paths: drift with the world, or be made new from the inside out.

nodes.content: How does renewing the mind change us, and what does it let us discern?

nodes.verseText: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.

nodes.content: The verse sets two paths against each other: "conformed to this world" versus "transformed." The change is inward - it happens "by the renewing of your mind."

nodes.verseText: to put off your former way of life, your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires; to be renewed in the spirit of your minds; and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away. Behold, the new has come!

nodes.content: The renewed mind has a purpose: "then you will be able to test and approve" God's will - discerning what is good, pleasing, and perfect.
